steps.en: Run AUTOMATIC1111's WebUI with the ControlNet extension, its models, and API mode on
steps.zh: 跑起装了 ControlNet 的 A1111 WebUI，开 API 模式

steps.en: Writes its config files and fetches the scribble/lineart ControlNet models your WebUI has
steps.zh: 生成配置文件，从 WebUI 拉取可用的 scribble/lineart 模型

steps.en: Type a prompt and start sketching on the canvas
steps.zh: 输入提示词，在画布上开画

steps.en: After each stroke, sends the sketch to the WebUI API as a ControlNet input
steps.zh: 每画一笔，就把草图作为 ControlNet 输入发给 WebUI API

steps.en: Replaces the preview with the generated image when it returns
steps.zh: 生成结果一回来，就替换预览画面

value.en: You compose by drawing rather than re-prompting, and the picture follows your strokes
value.zh: 你靠画而不是反复改提示词来构图，画面跟着笔触变

sources: https://github.com/houseofsecrets/SdPaint README Installation TLDR (WebUI + ControlNet extension, API mode, ControlNet v1.1 models), Configuration (configs\config.json etc., models fetched from your API), Controls (p = edit prompt) — read 2026-10-08
scripts/common/cn_requests.py at default branch (POSTs to sdapi/v1/txt2img or sdapi/v1/img2img)
